what: When hooks block with instructions (e.g. search hook says "call aide_search", read hook says "call aide_recall"), FOLLOW the hook instructions instead of bypassing with a different tool. The hooks are the product — if the agent ignores them, it undermines the entire value proposition.
why: User corrected: I re-ran grep instead of calling aide_search when the search hook blocked. The hook instructions exist to test and demonstrate the product flow.
